address: 12 East gate Street, Caernarfon, LL55 1AG, United Kingdom
bio: Named after two of the products for which Wales is best known, this unassuming former shop, tucked away in the town centre, features a ground floor kitchen and a basement restaurant with just six tables. Homegrown and local produce form the base of the set menu, where imaginative dishes show classic techniques and subtle global flavours....
